title: Blimey song (songs/<name>.yaml)
description: One song: the channel-2 Program Change that selects it and the cues its channel-2 notes fire. The song's name is its file name. Fixture, group and colour names, and programs shared by two songs, are checked by the engine at load.

program.description: Program Change value on channel 2, 0-127, unique across songs.

bpm.description: Tempo for beat and bar durations when no MIDI clock arrives. Defaults to 120.

audio.description: A bounce of the song, which the builder's timeline plays along with the lights. A missing file is not an error: the song plays silent.

file.description: Relative to the show folder, under audio/, which is kept out of git.

offset.description: Where bar 1 falls in the file, in ms or s. Defaults to 0s.

safe_look.description: What panic (channel 16, note 127) shows. Without it, panic goes dark.

sections.description: Section name → section: the parts of the song the arrangement places, each defined once.

arrangement.description: Section names in playing order, each as often as it plays. Without it, the song has no running order and bar lines follow time_signature throughout.

markers.description: Named points in the audio, as set in the DAW, drawn on the timeline as flags.

at.description: From the start of the audio file, in ms or s, so the marker stays on the music when the offset changes.

timeSignature.description: Beats per bar over the note value, e.g. 4/4 or 6/8. A beat is a quarter note, so a bar of 6/8 is 3 beats.

time_signature.description: For its bar lines and its blocks' bars, when it differs from the song's.

block.description: A scene held, as a channel-2 note, from bar and beat for length. It ends at or before the section's end; two blocks of one scene may not overlap. The engine checks both, and that the scene is in cues.

scene.description: The cue's note number, its key in cues.

beat.description: Beat of the bar, from 1, in quarter beats; fractions allowed. Defaults to 1.

length.description: In beats or bars of the section's time signature.

level.description: Scales the scene, as the note's velocity. Defaults to 100%.

pixel.description: Layers of preset shapes animated by effects over every pixel of every fixture and grid, in RGB, then converted per fixture. Fades in from note-on, scaled by velocity; fades out from note-off. Either layers, or one layer at the top of the cue (shape, effect, params) and an optional layer_2.

blend.description: How layer 2 combines with layer 1. Defaults to max.

rgbw.description: How RGBW pixels show the colour. Defaults to saturated.

seed.description: Fixes sparkle's and noise's random pattern. Defaults to 0.

layers.description: 1 to 8 layers, bottom first, each blended over the ones below it. A pixel no layer draws, outside every area or muted, keeps the layers below the cue.

area.description: The rectangle of the canvas the layer draws on, in canvas units: (x, y) is its bottom-left corner, y 0 the floor. The shape runs inside it: width and direction are relative to the area. Defaults to the whole canvas.

level.description: How much the layer shows: dims a max or add layer, as a scene's dimmer, and fades an over or mask layer into the ones below; at 0% the layer changes nothing. Defaults to 100%.

swell.description: The layer's own rhythm, timed as a swell cue: from note-on along curve over duration, then held. Scales the layer as level does. Not with pattern.

pattern.description: The layer's own rhythm, timed as a pattern cue: hits on a loop from the bar line after note-on, dark between them. Scales the layer as level does. Not with swell.

blend.description: How the layer meets the ones below it, inside its area: max (the brighter, per emitter), add (the sum, clipped), mask (the layers below show only where this one is lit) or over (this one covers them as much as it is lit; with a background, fully). Defaults to max.

mute.description: Fixtures, grids or groups the layer leaves to the layers below. The engine checks the names.

color.description: Palette name or #rrggbb. Defaults to white.

background.description: Where the shape isn't lit. Palette name or #rrggbb. Defaults to black.

width.description: 0-1 of the canvas, or of the layer's area: thickness of a bar or ring, step of a chase; on a fill, sweep, gradient or one-by-one sparkle, the particles' size, each pixel its own particle when unset. Defaults to 1.

repeat.description: How many of a bar, circle, split, diamond, diagonal or wedge show at once: evenly spaced copies that move at a single shape's speed, width scaled down to their spacing; on a fill, sweep, gradient or one-by-one sparkle, how many times each particle flashes per cycle. Defaults to 1.

speed.description: One cycle of the effect. Defaults to 1 bar.

direction.description: As seen from the audience; left-to-right is stage right to stage left. Defaults to left-to-right.

curve.description: A pulse's level over one cycle. Defaults to sine.

pattern.description: Envelope hits on the beats of a 1-4 bar loop. The loop starts on the bar line after note-on (at once if the note is within one MIDI clock tick after a bar line) and repeats until note-off, then fades out over release.

target.description: Either fixture or group → dimmer: the level scales their intensity, dark between hits. Or fixture or group → look settings: the level is how much of that look shows. Or pixel cue name → intensity: the level scales that cue's intensity.

at.description: Beat of the pattern, from 1, in quarter beats: 1, 2.5, 3.75. The engine checks it falls within the length.

length.description: In beats or bars, at most the pattern's length.

swell.description: A look reached along a curve over a duration from note-on, scaled by velocity, then held; fades out from note-off.

target.description: Fixture or group → look settings: the curve is how much of that look shows. Or pixel cue name → intensity: the curve scales that cue's intensity.

curve.description: How much of the target shows along the duration, 0-1. Defaults to ramp-up.

points.description: [time, level] pairs, both 0-1, times rising, joined by straight lines.

scene.description: A fixed look. Fades in from note-on, scaled by velocity; fades out from note-off.

duration.description: A number then a unit: 500ms, 2s, 0.5 beats, 4 bars. Beats and bars follow the MIDI clock, or the song's bpm without one. Fades and releases default to 0 (instant).

intensity.description: Name of a pixel cue of the same song → intensity. Every pixel cue of that name follows the level. The engine checks the names.

values.description: Fixture or group name → look settings, applied in order: a later entry wins on shared fixtures.
